Unpopular opinion: never buy a game at full price.

The Witcher 3 goes for a few dollars on sale and now includes every expansion. Patience pays. Cyberpunk 2077 at launch was a mess. Bought on sale years later, it was great. Wait a year and you get Elden Ring plus Shadow of the Erdtree for less. Agree?
